text: {"assertions":["A leaked field bug was found in platform/logging/redact.go where sensitive data was not being properly masked in log output.","The leaked field bug only occurred in jobs scheduled across midnight boundaries.","The root cause was an off-by-one error in a slice bound in the redactor.","The fix corrected the slice bound and added a property test to prevent regression.","The fix was submitted as PR #4899 on the fix/leaked-field-1 branch.","The bug was reproduced by logging the nested payload fixture.","After the fix, a previously flaky test went from 55 failures per 100 runs to zero failures.","The work was conducted on the platform side of the codebase."]}
